committees.name: Conference Committee
committees.currentFocus: Building the committee for the 2027 conference
committees.notes: Jennifer Anderson has been named co-chair alongside Mariel Hendricks. The committee roster is being finalized, with outreach to local AVTE members to round it out. Michele and Mariel have aligned on the needs, goals, and roles for the 2027 conference.
committees.nextSteps: Finalize committee participants and set the meeting schedule. Form subcommittees.

committees.name: JAVTE
committees.notes: The printed summer edition went out to conference attendees and was well received. The reviewer bench is full at 8 reviewers across 4 teams, with one more potential reviewer in conversation. An October meeting is being scheduled to plan the last edition of the 2026 cycle (the October 16 date may shift).
committees.nextSteps: Build a standing bank of articles so each edition has a pool to choose from. Hold the October planning meeting for the final 2026 edition.

committees.name: Resource Exchange
committees.currentFocus: Keeping the Resource Exchange a top AVTE priority after Portland
committees.notes: The committee debriefed the 2026 conference and discussed keeping the Resource Exchange front and center. The monthly engagement calendar is up and running, and the moderation system for reviewing resources is working well. A few participants have stepped away, and the committee does not need new members at this time. The meeting schedule is being adjusted.
committees.nextSteps: Upload past JAVTE materials to the library. Work with the Conference Committee to share 2027 conference materials on the Resource Exchange after the conference. Consider adding the engagement calendar to AVTE newsletter updates.

committees.name: Veterinary Technician Education Specialist (VTES)
committees.currentFocus: Building the question bank and setting testing windows
committees.notes: The online application process is complete. One exam has been rewritten for interim use while the committee builds a new question bank for multiple versions. One member now handles application reviews and another coordinates test dates and process. An SOP is in progress for exam windows, likely twice a year, with submission deadlines set to allow review and study time.
committees.nextSteps: Expand the question bank to support multiple exam versions. Finalize the SOP for testing windows. Reschedule the October 9 meeting.

committees.name: Awards Committee
committees.notes: No update this cycle. The Awards Committee's work is complete at this time.
committees.nextSteps: None this cycle; the committee reconvenes for the next conference cycle.

committees.name: Advocacy Committee
committees.notes: Tom Beall has stepped in as chair. The committee's review of the three AAVSB revision documents (VCPR model regulations, Article I, and Standards of Practice and Facility) is complete. No report was requested this cycle while the new chair gets started.
committees.nextSteps: Review committee roster and participation under the new chair.

committees.name: Leadership Development Committee
committees.notes: Mission Veterinary Partners is confirmed as a sponsor of ELEVATE. NAVTA and AVTE have completed an MOU covering NAVTA's support, and AVMA and AVTE are finalizing the details of AVMA's in-kind support. Registration has begun, with two forms received to date.
committees.nextSteps: Recruit program mentors. Program kickoff is still targeted for AVMA's 2027 VLC.

committees.name: Sponsorship Committee
committees.notes: A prospectus detailing sponsorship and partnership opportunities has been created and is in final review before it goes to industry partners.
committees.nextSteps: Reach out to program directors for possible sponsorship contacts. Share the prospectus with potential sponsors.

committees.name: Fellows in Veterinary Technician Education (FVTE)
committees.currentFocus: Chair transition and piloting Senior FVTE with current Fellows
committees.notes: Erin Dahlstrom has taken over as chair from Tara Groves. Tara, Erin, and Michele met to set the schedule, and the committee returns to meeting every three weeks starting September 25. Senior FVTE requirements are essentially final. The committee will pilot them with current Fellows who are not on the board to see how many qualify, and may adjust requirements from there. The quarterly speaker was set for September 23.
committees.nextSteps: Run the Senior FVTE pilot with current Fellows and push for applications. Schedule the next quarterly speakers.

committees.name: Membership Committee
committees.notes: Brand new committee. Nicole Riggs has been named chair. Recruitment and retention focus. No report was requested this cycle while the committee gets started.

committees.name: Vet Tech New Faculty Academy
committees.chair: Rebecca Newman (Appalachian State University) & Laura Neely (KCTCS), Co-Directors
committees.notes: Board-approved virtual program for educators new to vet tech education, with mentorship through December. 42 faculty are registered. Program faculty is confirmed. Work is underway to finalize the affiliated mentors.

committees.name: AVTE Standards Series (CVTEA Webinar Program)
committees.currentFocus: Restarting conversations in late August to push the program forward
committees.notes: 11-month virtual webinar series, September to July, one session per CVTEA Accreditation Standard. Board approved. Karla Lombana has agreed to co-chair. The concept is in place but needs a push. Conversations are restarting in late August to move it forward. Feeds into Resource Exchange discussion threads.
committees.nextSteps: Restart the working conversations in late August. Recruit a co-chair partner to join Karla Lombana. Recruit presenters for Standards 1 to 4. Set up Resource Exchange threads.

committees.name: Career Center
committees.currentFocus: Live on the new platform, building marketing and outreach
committees.notes: Migration complete. Exit paperwork is signed and AVTE is live on the new YM Careers (AVMA) platform. W-9 complete, logo submitted, launch call done. Attention has shifted to strengthening marketing and outreach now that the switch is done.
committees.nextSteps: Develop the marketing and outreach approach for the career center. Share a recommended direction in the October to November window for new year implementation.

committees.name: Merchandise
committees.notes: Transitioning AVTE branded merchandise to a new online store platform.
committees.nextSteps: Complete platform transition and relaunch store.

committees.name: VT Inclusion, Diversity, Equity & Success (VTIDES)
committees.notes: Active grant management. Ongoing initiative, not a formal committee.

committees.name: VTNE Advocacy / External Relations
committees.currentFocus: Coalition gap analysis agreed, next steps in motion ahead of September
committees.notes: Active multi-party partnership with AAVSB, AVMA, NAVTA, CVTEA, and the Canadian VMA. VTNE/CVTEA crosswalk completed. The July meeting at the AVMA Convention in Anaheim was a success, with agreement on the gap analysis and next steps identified for every group. AAVSB bylaw change proposal went public mid-May 2026. Comms plan active.
committees.nextSteps: Groups work their assigned next steps from the gap analysis. Reconvene in September at the AAVSB conference, date set and invites sent. Execute Phase 1 comms plan. Coordinate Portland conference fireside chat.
